samples.transcript: How can a clock tell a ship where it is? Sailors use the Sun to find local time, corrected to match the clock’s timekeeping. Twelve at the reference. Two in the afternoon locally. Two hours ahead. Thirty degrees east. The clock carries time. Observation and calculation reveal longitude.
